description:
The well-known solitaire card game, FreeCell, is here!
Sort your cards wisely and align them orderly.
It comes with smooth animation in crisp movement, and a guide function making it easy to operate.
Attain the height in time record, or collect reward cat images by clearing the questions.
A light game which can be enjoyed far into the future!
